messages.subject: Your Porn Fetch license
messages.body:
Thank you for supporting Porn Fetch. Your signed license file {filename} is attached.

Your license includes one year of updates from first activation. You may continue using versions released during that paid year; newer releases require another purchase. There is no automatic Porn Fetch license renewal. Normal activation and periodic validation requirements still apply.

If you paid through Patreon, cancel your membership immediately after your first successful payment to prevent further Patreon charges. Cancelling does not revoke this issued license. Cancellation instructions: https://support.patreon.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360005502572-Cancelling-a-paid-membership

Save the attachment and import it through the license activation screen in Porn Fetch. The file does not contain your email address.

If you did not request this license, contact the operator using the address in the legal notice; do not send sensitive data.
messages.legacy_beta_body:
Thank you for supporting the project. Your signed license file {filename} is attached to this email.

Save the attachment and select it from the license activation screen in Porn Fetch. The file does not contain your email address and can be verified offline.

If you did not request a license, do not reply with sensitive data; contact the operator using the address shown in the legal notice.
